name: Data Analyzer: Hostile dictionary content is displayed as plain text, never as an image
objective: Proves a dictionary parsed by the (fake) AI that contains image syntax pointing at an attacker address is shown harmlessly.
precondition: The page runs in a headless test harness (no browser) with the AI dictionary parser replaced by a fake, a temporary cache folder and development mode. The fake parser returns a field whose name, description and allowed value all contain '![beacon](https://attacker.invalid/p.png?x=1)' (made-up).

steps.action: Open the page and upload a text dictionary file
steps.expected: No exception; the fake parser is called once

steps.action: Look at every displayed text containing 'beacon'
steps.expected: At least one exists; none contains the raw '![beacon]'; each contains the escaped form

name: Data Analyzer: Oversized data file upload is refused with a message
objective: Proves a data file over the limit is not loaded and the user is told the limit.
precondition: The page runs in a headless test harness (no browser) with the AI dictionary parser replaced by a fake, a temporary cache folder and development mode. The upload limit is set to 1 MB.

steps.action: Upload a CSV of about 2.4 MB
steps.expected: An error mentioning 'upload limit is 1 MB' appears, and the stored data is empty

name: Data Analyzer: Oversized dictionary upload is refused with a message
objective: Proves a dictionary file over the limit is rejected before parsing.
precondition: The page runs in a headless test harness (no browser) with the AI dictionary parser replaced by a fake, a temporary cache folder and development mode. The upload limit is set to 1 MB.

steps.expected: An error mentioning 'upload limit is 1 MB' appears and the parser is never called

name: Data Analyzer: PDF dictionary with too many pages is refused in the AI parsing mode
objective: Proves the PDF page limit message shows to the user in the default (AI) mode.
precondition: The page runs in a headless test harness (no browser) with the AI dictionary parser replaced by a fake, a temporary cache folder and development mode. PDF page limit is 2.

steps.action: Upload a blank 3-page PDF made in memory
steps.expected: An error saying '3 pages; the limit is 2' appears and the AI parser is not called

name: Data Analyzer: PDF dictionary with too many pages is refused in manual (no AI) mode
objective: Proves the same limit applies when AI is switched off.
precondition: The page runs in a headless test harness (no browser) with the AI dictionary parser replaced by a fake, a temporary cache folder and development mode. PDF page limit is 2.

steps.action: Upload a blank 3-page PDF, then choose 'Never use AI (manual only)' as the dictionary parsing method
steps.expected: An error saying '3 pages; the limit is 2' appears

name: Data Analyzer: A wrongly structured JSON dictionary gives a clear on-screen error
objective: Proves the page reports a structural problem instead of crashing.
precondition: The page runs in a headless test harness (no browser) with the AI dictionary parser replaced by a fake, a temporary cache folder and development mode.

steps.action: Upload a JSON dictionary where 'fields' is an object instead of a list, then choose manual-only parsing
steps.expected: The page raises no exception and shows an error containing 'must be a list'

name: Data Analyzer: A cached dictionary result is reused by its own session but not by another session
objective: Proves cache isolation between users end to end.
precondition: The page runs in a headless test harness (no browser) with the AI dictionary parser replaced by a fake, a temporary cache folder and development mode.

steps.action: Session 1 uploads a dictionary, then the page is re-run
steps.expected: The parser was called once in total (second time came from session 1's cache)

steps.action: A new session uploads identical bytes
steps.expected: The parser is called again (2 calls in total) and the two sessions have different session identifiers

name: Data Analyzer: The 'Clear my cache' button clears only the current session's cache
objective: Proves one user's clear button leaves another user's cached result and does not show the server folder path.
precondition: The page runs in a headless test harness (no browser) with the AI dictionary parser replaced by a fake, a temporary cache folder and development mode.

steps.action: Two sessions each upload a different dictionary ('bytes A', 'bytes B'), then session A presses 'Clear my cache'
steps.expected: Session A re-parses its still-uploaded file (3 parser calls in total)

steps.action: Re-run session B and look at the page text
steps.expected: No new parser call (still 3); B's cache still has 1 entry; the temporary cache folder path does not appear on A's page

name: Data Analyzer: Page never shows a server folder path or a global 'Clear All Cache' option
objective: Proves the page does not reveal where files are stored on the server.
precondition: The page runs in a headless test harness (no browser) with the AI dictionary parser replaced by a fake, a temporary cache folder and development mode.

steps.action: Upload a dictionary and read all displayed text and button labels
steps.expected: The temporary cache folder path and 'Cache location' do not appear and no button reads 'Clear All Cache'

name: Data Analyzer: Uploaded file names are not written to the logs
objective: Proves names such as 'SITE-017_secret_study.txt' do not show in captured log messages.
precondition: The page runs in a headless test harness (no browser) with the AI dictionary parser replaced by a fake, a temporary cache folder and development mode. Log capture is on at the most detailed level.

steps.action: Upload a dictionary file and a data file with identifiable made-up names
steps.expected: The captured log text contains neither 'SITE-017' nor 'secret_study'. Only Python logging is captured, not text printed directly
